name: Grow a Universe 🌌
desc:
🪐Welcome to Grow a Universe🪐

Are you ready to grow your very own universe? Buy seeds from the shop when they restock, plant them, wait for them to grow, and collect the profits! Flex planets on friends, and have fun!

[How To Plant]
• Equip your planet seed you want to plant!
• Click in your farm on the brown plots to plant!
• Wait to see it start growing!
• After its fully grown, it is time to harvest the planets!

Grow your own universe from stars to galaxies! Just like Grow a Garden, but in space! Unlock planets, harvest cosmic resources, and expand your galaxy. 

Remember, your universe literally grows while you are offline! ⭐

Tags: grow a galaxy, grow a universe, idle garden, clicker, offline growth
